items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Barnet was playing in the Ball Room in 1939. ... Al Killian had left us earlier. Before I went in the Army he left us to join Charlie Barnet.

ctx.x: What was the beginning of the 40's like with you, Jo? Do you remember?
Oh, sure...J: In 1939 we went to California. We were supposed to open up at the Ball Room where Mr. Benny Goodman had played. Charlie Barnet was playing in the Ball Room in 1939.
